# THIS FILE IS AUTOMATICALLY GENERATED BY CARGO
#
# When uploading crates to the registry Cargo will automatically
# "normalize" Cargo.toml files for maximal compatibility
# with all versions of Cargo and also rewrite `path` dependencies
# to registry (e.g., crates.io) dependencies.
#
# If you are reading this file be aware that the original Cargo.toml
# will likely look very different (and much more reasonable).
# See Cargo.toml.orig for the original contents.

[package]
edition = "2021"
rust-version = "1.60"
name = "foldhash"
version = "0.1.5"
authors = ["Orson Peters <orsonpeters@gmail.com>"]
build = false
exclude = [
    "benches",
    "tools",
    "assets",
]
autolib = false
autobins = false
autoexamples = false
autotests = false
autobenches = false
description = "A fast, non-cryptographic, minimally DoS-resistant hashing algorithm."
readme = "README.md"
keywords = [
    "hash",
    "hasher",
    "no-std",
]
categories = [
    "algorithms",
    "no-std",
]
license = "Zlib"
repository = "https://github.com/orlp/foldhash"

[features]
default = ["std"]
std = []

[lib]
name = "foldhash"
path = "src/lib.rs"
bench = false

[dependencies]

[dev-dependencies.ahash]
version = "0.8"

[dev-dependencies.chrono]
version = "0.4"

[dev-dependencies.criterion]
version = "0.5"

[dev-dependencies.fxhash]
version = "0.2"

[dev-dependencies.hashbrown]
version = "0.14"

[dev-dependencies.rand]
version = "0.8"

[dev-dependencies.uuid]
version = "1.8"

[profile.release]
lto = "thin"

The native CLI was inspected without Python/Lua; nine source archives and their root licenses were verified. Its generated Bison parsers carry a GPL notice and a larger-work exception whose scope has not been certified under the closed policy. This does not classify the whole MIT-root Clingo project as GPL-only or paid. No build, adapter or runtime acceptance yet. Evidence: sources/review-clingo-dependencies666.json.

assessment_before_owner_decision.note: Original libclingo links libgringo, whose PUBLIC links require mpark::variant and math::wide_integer. Both exact vendored submodules have reviewed Boost Software License 1.0 texts. This permissive license is outside the closed allowlist. No native or Python SDK was installed; no claim of a complete review of every dependency.

records.note: Zlib is owner-approved but the exact native dependency profile is still unprepared. Original core CMake includes libtai unconditionally; its INSTALL/BLURB explicitly state public domain, whose mapping to the closed approved list remains pending. The embedded SHA1 notice has a permissive three-condition alternative, so it is not classified as GPL-only. No source was altered, runtime built or license newly approved.

assessment_before_native_review.note: Follow-up source review confirms cmake/Dependencies.cmake calls find_package(ZLIB REQUIRED) unconditionally. The supported USE_GMP=OFF / USE_LIBBF=ON options avoid GMP but do not eliminate this native dependency. An exact selected ZLIB artifact, all other selected native libraries, dependency-license closure and source build remain unprepared. No native runtime installed or upstream build failure asserted. Zlib itself is now owner-approved; selecting and reading the exact dependency artifact and preparing the remaining closure are still required.

records.note: The core-only Linux candidate resolves 97 active packages and obligatorily selects colored 2.2.0. Its original LICENSE at ef1484c713e1340d842cc7b76f79dc976afe891f matches the fixed archive and is MPL-2.0, outside policy. The separately examined minimum-compatible 2.0.0 has the same original license text. No source was compiled and no dependency build script or runtime was executed; no requirement removed and no connection counted.

assessment_before_dependency_review.note: Original core requires colored 2.0, native/sparse math dependencies and an unpinned chronoutil Git dependency. Exact resolved versions and license closure still require review. No SDK or build installed; findings for other colored versions are not automatically extended.

records.note: Original package declares no runtime Python dependencies but deliberately includes maxsatz source and solver license files in package-data. The bundled maxsatz text identifies GPL-2.0, outside policy. A core-only distribution permitted by the original build has not been established. No SDK or solver installed.

Original setup.py requires NetworkX, PyYAML, pandas, Numba, NumPy, memory_profiler and pytest, with Python-version-dependent ranges. CPU runtime, exact dependency licenses and a bounded operation remain pending; no SDK installed.

Original root CMake builds staged compilers and obtains Cadical, leantar and optional mimalloc. Exact artifact provenance, selected native dependency licenses and a resource-bounded proof operation require preparation. Only the root tree and root CMake were inspected, not a recursive full-source review. No build attempted.

Original Python package requires ray[default], PyGithub, lxml, networkx, GitPython and process tooling. The Lean runtime and dependency closure are not prepared. No SDK installed, no remote repository checkout or theorem environment executed.

Pinned original Egg with default-features=false, 40 source files and 14 symbol_table files verified, all 21 registry archives and original selected licenses reviewed. Seven Engine cases and 200 independent finite-reference checks passed, with joined txtai CLI/MCP/restart acceptance. Compiler/platform license closure and production verification remain unclaimed.
